description: Marketplace-level PROGRAM (ad-attributed) vs SITE (organic) funnel for a single period: a one-row aggregate across every seller of the agency. PROGRAM metrics come from per-click-timestamp attribution in client_vendor_channel_performance_facts; SITE metrics are correlated subqueries over monetize_merchant_facts. Spend and revenue are converted to the marketplace currency. Request `spend` alone for the total program-spend check. NOTE: `channel` is a FILTER-ONLY attribute -- this template has no __ATTRIBUTES__ placeholder, so channel can be filtered (PLA = os_product_ads, Display = guaranteed_display_ads / auction_display_ads) but never grouped by. The report is single-period; fetch current and baseline separately.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.cost * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Total program (advertising) spend over the period, converted to the marketplace currency.

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: Program ad impressions over the period.

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
clicks.description: Program ad clicks over the period.

program_gmv.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.program_per_click_timestamp_sales ELSE 0 END), 0)
program_gmv.description: Ad-attributed GMV (program sales), per-click-timestamp attribution, in source units.

program_orders.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.program_per_click_timestamp_conversions ELSE 0 END), 0)

program_viewproducts.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.program_per_click_timestamp_viewproduct ELSE 0 END), 0)

program_add2carts.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN cvcpf.program_per_click_timestamp_add_to_cart ELSE 0 END), 0)

site_revenue.description: Total organic site GMV (total SOK sales) over the period, converted to the marketplace currency.

site_orders.description: Total organic site orders (total SOK sale-completes) over the period.

site_viewproducts.description: Total organic site product views (total SOK view-products) over the period.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __METRICS__ FROM reporting.client_vendor_channel_performance_facts AS cvcpf INNER JOIN reporting.clients AS clients ON clients.client_id = cvcpf.client_id AND clients.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' INNER JOIN reporting.marketplace_clients AS mc ON mc.agency_id = clients.agency_id AND clients.client_id != mc.marketplace_client_id INNER JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc ON scc.from_currency = cvcpf.currency AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(mmf.total_sok_sales_usd * scc2.conversion_factor) AS site_revenue, SUM(mmf.total_sok_salecompletes) AS site_orders, SUM(mmf.total_sok_viewproducts) AS site_viewproducts, SUM(mmf.total_sok_add2carts) AS site_add2carts FROM reporting.monetize_merchant_facts AS mmf INNER JOIN reporting.marketplace_clients AS mc2 ON mmf.agency_id = mc2.agency_id AND mmf.marketplace_client_id = mc2.marketplace_client_id INNER JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc2 ON scc2.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc2.to_currency = mc2.currency WHERE mmf.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND mmf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__') AS site WHERE cvcpf.vendor = 'os_ads' AND cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__;
